# Plotly.js

The Cartesian bundle is vendored so statistics do not need an external CDN.
It includes the scatter, heatmap, and pie trace types used by this application.

- Version: **4.1.1**
- Bundle: <https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-cartesian-4.1.1.min.js>
- Upstream: <https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/releases/tag/v4.1.1>
- License: MIT, included in `plotly-LICENSE.txt`
- Bundle SHA-256: `79542150855a52c567260e3137095dbe2b744e6d702a5cabe67da246942fba7a`

When updating, replace the bundle and license together, update the template URL,
and verify zoom synchronization, hover values, responsive layouts, and PNG fallback.
